scheme_name: Thatched House Repair Grant for Re-thatching & Repairs (Sainik Welfare)
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Ex‑serviceman, Widow of an Ex‑serviceman, or Dependent of an Ex‑serviceman.
Applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry.
Applicant must be receiving a Subsistence Allowance.
Applicant must be living in a thatched house.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹40,000 is provided for re‑thatching and repair of the house, credited to the beneficiary’s bank account via RTGS/NEFT.
